title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. It can help reduce variance but might not always reduce bias. Consider how regularization affects the model's ability to fit the training data.

title: Effect of Regularization on Bias
text: Does regularization typically increase or decrease model bias?

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: The bias-variance tradeoff is a fundamental concept in machine learning. Increasing regularization can increase bias while decreasing variance. Think about how this tradeoff affects the model's predictions.

title: Impact of Regularization on Bias Squared
text: If a model already has high bias, what is the likely effect of adding regularization?

title: Analyzing the Model Equation
text: The model equation is $$y=\theta_0+\theta_1 {x_1}^2+\theta_2 \sqrt{x_2}$$. Consider how each term contributes to the model's predictions and how regularization might affect these terms.
